name: zotero-arxiv-source-helper
description: Automatically retain arXiv TeX source in Zotero and query it locally by section or table.

scripts.test: node --test --test-isolation=none tests/core.test.mjs tests/runtime.test.mjs tests/package.test.mjs tests/figures.test.mjs tests/query.test.mjs tests/conversion.test.mjs
scripts.check: node --check bootstrap.js && node --check query.mjs && node --check scripts/convert.mjs
